Tara (Product): Quick heads-up: function-calling + streaming combo is GA on Hosted API today. New endpoint and lightweight SDK helpers are rolling to all regions over the next 3 hours. :tada:

Emil (Runtime): Nice! What's the new surface? Any breaking changes?

Tara (Product): New endpoint: POST /v1/stream/function-call. Supports streaming responses while invoking customer-provided functions (callbacks) triggered mid-stream. Backwards-compatible with existing function-calling; clients that want streaming+functions should migrate to this endpoint.

Rosa (SRE): Rollout plan? Canary and metrics to monitor?

Tara (Product): Canary in us-east-1 for 20m, then staged ramp. Watch function.callback_latency_p95, stream.first_byte_p99, and router.function_fallback_rate. Pager if fallback_rate > 2% for 10m.

DeployBot: deploy started: hosted-fnstream v1.0.0 -> canary(us-east-1) at 1874506900. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/hosted-fnstream/1.0.0

Emil (Runtime): Runtime notes: we prefetch function manifests and keep warm connections for callback URLs. Also added an opt-in header X-Redwood-Fn-Mode: streaming|buffered to control whether function outputs are sent back mid-stream or batched at the end. Default is streaming.

Ben (Docs): I need sample curl + SDK snippets and a small migration note for customers using function_call in non-streaming endpoints. ETA?

Tara (Product): Sample curl below. Migration note: existing function_call payloads continue to work with /v1/chat/completions, but will not receive streaming function events. Recommend switching to /v1/stream/function-call for UI flows that need partial function results.

Tara (Product): Example curl (streaming function-call):
```
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/function-call \\ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Fn-Mode: streaming" \\ 
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-3b","prompt":"Process this doc","function_call":{"name":"extract_entities","webhook":"https://hooks.example/fn"}}'
```

Rosa (SRE): New error codes: 4733 = fn.backoff (router temporarily steering away from callbacks), 4734 = fn.misfire (function invocation failed server-side). Adding runbook entry: if 4733 spike, reduce concurrency or switch to buffered mode.

SupportBot: Support snippet: "If users see 4734, confirm webhook health and request-id. Recommend retries with jitter and fallback to buffered mode if persistent."

Emil (Runtime): Minor ops note: we increased default webhook connection timeout and added a callback retry window (3 attempts with exponential backoff). No customer changes required unless they want different retry policies (route-level config coming soon).

Ben (Docs): I'll publish quickstart + SDK examples (Node + Python) in ~90 minutes and add cost/latency tradeoffs. Also adding note about X-Redwood-Fn-Mode and webhook best-practices.

DeployBot: canary completed: hosted-fnstream v1.0.0 -> us-east-1 OK (1874507580). Next region: eu-west-1 at +15m.

Tara (Product): Thanks team. Please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your tasks. We'll monitor metrics for 2 hours and follow up in #incidents if anything notable shows up.

Emil (Runtime): :thumbsup:

Rosa (SRE): :thumbsup:

Ben (Docs): :thumbsup:

Tara (Product): Rollout complete across regions at 1874509760. If you observe customer impact, ping me or @oncall immediately.
